note: Two real-user bugs fixed. Mistral 422 no longer kills the conversation. Content-policy refusals from cloud providers now detect status 422 451 and policy-language errors as not-a-health-issue. If Browser AI is loaded the system fails over silently with provenance and depth consent intact. Otherwise the user sees a clear path-forward message instead of a raw error code. Core planting char limits raised. Paula's poem wouldn't fit at 280. Seed contributions now get 1000 chars and Branch plus Fruit get 2500. Mobile textarea min-height raised from 44px to 120px so there is actual room to write a stanza.
